verdict.rationale: Cal.com's docs list "payments" among core platform capabilities (cal-com-docs-28/48) and webhook events explicitly include BOOKING_PAYMENT_INITIATED and BOOKING_PAID, confirming a payment-at-booking flow exists (cal-com-docs-5/26/42). However, the evidence pack lacks any Stripe-specific setup docs, API fields for configuring a paid event type, or a hands-on confirmation that a booking actually triggers a Stripe charge. Missing for 10: dedicated Stripe/payment-app integration docs, API examples showing price/currency fields on event-type creation, and independent/hands-on verification of a successful paid booking flow.
